name: shimmering shield
desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} targets itself or one [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=sl8NoPhB0e5z6jmK]] it can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=sl8NoPhB0e5z6jmK]] feet of itself. The target gains [[/healing average temp]], and its AC increases by 2 until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s' next turn. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
